onekey.quick_stack.none: No matching containers or items to transfer

onekey.compat.conflict_detected: §e[OneKey] Detected compatible inventory mod(s): %s. OneKey has adapted interactions to avoid conflicts.
onekey.settings.title: OneKey Settings
onekey.settings.tip.locking: Tip: Hover over slot and press %s to lock/unlock it
onekey.settings.tip.hotbar: Rule: hotbar involvement is controlled by the toggles above; locked slots never move
onekey.settings.tip.sort_1: Tip: Press R to sort container or inventory; scattered stacks merge first
onekey.settings.tip.stack_1: Targeted: Press B to prioritize targeted container (or open screen)
onekey.settings.tip.stack_2: Smart Stash: New items will only enter targeted chest, keeping categories safe
onekey.settings.tip.sweep: Sweep: Hold Shift + LMB drag across slots to continuously move items
onekey.settings.tip.repeat: Placement: Hold RMB drag circles while holding items to repeatedly drop items
onekey.settings.tip.wheel: Wheel: Scroll on slots to move single items; scroll down while holding to drop 1
onekey.settings.tip.excavator_1: Tip: Hold ~ (Grave key) while breaking a block to trigger vein mining
onekey.settings.tip.excavator_2: Mode Cycle: Hold ~ and scroll mouse wheel to cycle between Vein, 1x2 Tunnel, and 3x3 Tunnel
onekey.settings.tip.excavator_3: Anti-Cheat: Mismatched tools or bare hands will not trigger vein mining, preserving balance
onekey.settings.openKeybinds.tooltip: Open vanilla Controls & Key Binds menu to configure hotkeys like R/V/B/K and slot locking
onekey.settings.resetDefaults.tooltip: Reset all configuration options across all tabs to factory defaults
onekey.settings.done.tooltip: Save and immediately apply all changes, returning to game
onekey.settings.tab.sort.tooltip: Switch to One-Key Sorting configuration (sorting rules, stack merging, orders)
onekey.settings.tab.stack.tooltip: Switch to Quick Stack & Stash configuration (crosshair priority, radius, protection)
onekey.settings.tab.gestures.tooltip: Switch to Mouse Gestures configuration (LMB sweep, RMB repeat, wheel tweaks)
onekey.settings.tab.excavator.tooltip: Switch to Vein Mining configuration (shapes, limits, leaf harvesting, tool protection)
onekey.settings.sort.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable One-Key Sorting (press R) functionality
onekey.settings.sort.mergeStacks.tooltip: Automatically merge scattered partial stacks into full stacks before sorting
onekey.settings.sort.includeHotbar.toolt: Whether sorting affects the hotbar (slots 1-9); locked slots are always excluded
onekey.settings.sort.cooldown.tooltip: Minimum cooldown between sorting requests to prevent network packet spam
onekey.settings.sort.groupByCategory.too: Group items by category (equipment, building, tools, resources, etc.) first
onekey.settings.sort.sortByName.tooltip: Sort items alphabetically by localized display name within each category
onekey.settings.sort.sortByCountDesc.too: Sort items with higher counts first for cleaner inventory appearance
onekey.settings.quickStack.crosshairPrio: Prioritize the container directly targeted by crosshairs (stash where you look)
onekey.settings.quickStack.smartMatching: Smart Category Protection: only deposit items into containers that already match category
onekey.settings.quickStack.radius.toolti: Maximum block radius scanned for nearby containers during Quick Stack / Stash
onekey.settings.quickStack.stashMode.too: Stash mode: only restock existing items or dump all unlocked inventory items into targeted chest
onekey.settings.gestures.lmbDragSweep.to: Hold Shift and drag LMB across slots to rapidly transfer items to/from chest
onekey.settings.gestures.rmbDragRepeat.t: Hold RMB and drag across slots with carried item; re-entering a slot drops another item
onekey.settings.gestures.invertWheel.too: Invert mouse scroll wheel transfer direction (ideal for macOS natural scrolling)
onekey.settings.gestures.wheelCarriedHan: Scroll down while holding an item on cursor to place 1 item into hovered slot
onekey.settings.gestures.includeHotbar.t: Whether mouse gestures (Shift sweep, wheel tweaks) are allowed to touch hotbar items
onekey.settings.excavator.enabled.toolti: On multiplayer servers these switches can only tighten the server config (disabling stops vein mining immediately); creative and spectator modes never trigger it
onekey.settings.excavator.maxBlocks.tool: Maximum number of blocks to mine in a single vein action (16 - 128)
Harvest connected leaves when felling trees (disabled by default)
onekey.settings.excavator.preventToolBre: Automatically stops mining when tool durability drops to 2 or below
onekey.settings.excavator.requireValidTo: Requires an effective, matching tool to prevent bare-hand or exploit mining
onekey.settings.excavator.consolidateDro: Merges drops into full stacks and groups XP orbs at the origin block to eliminate lag
